name: HiDream-O1-Image-Dev FP8
notes: 8B pixel-space unified transformer. No VAE/CLIP dependency. FP8 ~10 GB VRAM. Native ComfyUI workflow at docs.comfy.org/tutorials/image/hidream/hidream-o1. Dev variant: 28 steps, CFG=0.0, ~2x faster. Competes with FLUX.2-dev 56B per WaveSpeed eval. New alternative backbone for build_txt2img/build_img2img — NOT a drop-in for Klein presets.

name: HiDream-O1-Image-Dev FP8
notes: Same HiDream model supports img2img mode natively. Alternative backbone; does not replace Klein presets.

name: ComfyUI Native BiRefNet Loader
notes: Same BiRefNet-general weights; ComfyUI now loads natively without community custom node dependency. Simplification only — no quality change. Switch build_rembg_birefnet to native loader once server is on v0.21+.

name: Netflix VOID (Video Object and Interaction Deletion)
notes: Physics-aware object removal: erases shadows, reflections, motion-caused artifacts via quadmask (4-value greyscale). Pass 1 = base inpaint, Pass 2 = optical-flow refinement. VRAM estimated ~40 GB for video mode — HARD SKIP on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Investigate if image-only Pass 1 fits in 16 GB; if yes, promote to Tier 2.

name: Netflix VOID
notes: Same as magic_eraser entry. Architecture strictly better than LaMa but VRAM blocks 16 GB deployment for video mode.

name: ComfyUI-ReActor v0.7.0 Alpha2 + HyperSwap models
notes: ReActor v0.7.0 Alpha2 (May 12, just outside 7-day window): removes InsightFace monkey-patch, adds gender detection fix. Supports HyperSwap models (hyperswap_1a/1b/1c_256.onnx) from FaceFusion Labs — claimed higher cosine similarity than inswapper_128. Additive: existing inswapper_128.onnx still works. New 'Face Similarity' QC node.

name: HyperSwap ONNX models
notes: hyperswap_1a_256.onnx, hyperswap_1b_256.onnx, hyperswap_1c_256.onnx. Place in ComfyUI/models/hyperswap/. Additive alternative to inswapper_128.onnx.

name: FlashVSR v1.1
notes: CVPR 2026 peer-reviewed. One-step diffusion streaming VSR. Locality-constrained sparse attention for real-time inference. 2x and 4x upscale. Auto-downloads weights from HF. Multiple community ComfyUI nodes. Alternative/complement to SeedVR2.

name: FlashVSR v1.1
notes: Same as video_upscale entry. CVPR 2026 one-step diffusion alternative to SeedVR2-class upscalers.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org)
notes: On RTX 5060 Ti uses dedicated Tensor Core path. Claimed 30x faster than diffusion upscalers. Non-diffusion (artifact reduction vs detail hallucination). Official Comfy-Org node. Best as fast-path option in build_upscale, not a quality replacement for SeedVR2/SUPIR.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution
notes: Same as build_upscale entry. Could serve as fast-path in blend pipeline.

name: Topaz Astra 2 / Starlight Precise 2.5
notes: Astra 2 (diffusion creative upscale, 450 frames max) + Starlight Precise 2.5 (6B diffusion precision). May 7 Expansion Release adds SDR-to-HDR. ComfyUI partner nodes. 12 GB VRAM minimum. Proprietary license is the barrier; not recommended for open-source stack.

name: Pixal3D (TencentARC)
notes: Pixel-Aligned 3D Generation from Images. Back-projection conditioning for direct pixel-to-3D correspondences. Addresses fidelity issues in HunyuanVideo3D. 185 likes in 10 days. Active HF Space. No ComfyUI node yet. VRAM TBC (TRELLIS-class, likely 12-16 GB). Build custom node for build_pixal3d_mesh.

name: Pixal3D (TencentARC)
notes: Same as build_hunyuan_3d_mesh. Pixal3D handles geometry; texture pipeline TBC. Also note: Hunyuan3D 3.0 via Partner Nodes (Feb 2026, cloud API) and Hunyuan3D 2.1 (Oct 2025, open weights, 457K downloads) as intermediate upgrade options.

name: BFS Best-Face-Swap LoRA
notes: FLUX.2-Klein 9B + Qwen LoRA for face/head swap. 98K downloads, 564 likes. Active HF Space linoyts/Flux2-Klein-Face-Swap (394 likes). Fork uploaded 2026-05-19 (in window). Additive — improves identity preservation in build_klein_headswap. Inject via existing lora_chain mechanism with arch_key=flux2klein.

name: Wan 2.7 (pending local weights)
notes: MoE 27B total/14B active. 4-in-1: T2V, I2V, FLF2V, VideoEdit. Multi-image input (9-grid), vocal timbre reference, video continuation. Supersedes full Wan 2.x stack once local weights release. Estimated ~14 GB FP8. No Wan-AI HuggingFace entry for 2.7 as of 2026-05-22. Monitor Wan-AI org.

name: Wan 2.7 (pending)
notes: Wan 2.7 T2V supersedes build_wan22_t2v once weights drop. No action until local weights confirmed.

name: Wan 2.7 FLF2V (pending)
notes: Wan 2.7 includes FLF2V (first+last frame) mode. Pending local weights.

name: LTX-2.3 22B (verify upgrade path)
notes: Codebase references LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors suggesting LTX 2.3 VAE is already loaded. Need to verify if the UNET is the 22B LTX-2.3 DiT (Mar 2026) vs older 13B LTX-2 (Jan 2026). GGUF Q4 fits 16 GB. Audio+video in one pass. Check video_presets.py model filename against Lightricks/LTX-2.3 HF repo.

name: IC-Light V2 (Flux-based)
notes: IC-Light V2 is Flux-based (vs SD1.5 in spellcaster). Better detail preservation on stylized images. Full open weights NOT confirmed released as of 2026-05-22 — HF Space demo only. ComfyUI nodes exist. When weights fully release, wire as build_iclight_v2 alongside existing SD1.5 builder. Also: PIXLRelight (paper 2026-05-18, in window) but NO weights yet.

name: VOSR (vision-only SR)
notes: Generative SR without SDXL backbone. One-step inference mode. Claimed <1/10 SUPIR training cost, competitive perceptual quality. Diffusers format on HF. No ComfyUI node confirmed. Lower VRAM profile than SUPIR (no SDXL dependency). Worth benchmarking. Outside 7-day window.

name: FaceFusion 4.0 (standalone app, not ComfyUI native)
notes: FaceFusion 4.0 libraries bundle released 2026-05-18 (in window). Major version. Uses ONNX swapper stack claimed superior to inswapper_128. No ComfyUI node — not a direct drop-in for build_faceswap. Monitor for facefusion/models-4.0.0 drop; may provide updated ONNX swapper compatible with ReActor.

name: Seedream 5.0 Lite (cloud API / Partner Node)
notes: ByteDance Seedream 5.0 Lite. Web-connected retrieval, strong instruction following. Released ~2026-05-15 via ComfyUI partner nodes. Cloud API only — no local weights. Informational for spellcaster's local-first stack. Not actionable without API key.

name: Hunyuan 3D 3.0 (Partner Nodes / cloud)
notes: Hunyuan 3D 3.0 in ComfyUI via Partner Nodes since Feb 2026. Text/image/sketch → 3D in one pass. Better quality than 2.0. Cloud API, no local weights. Consider exposing as cloud-mode option if user has Tencent API key.

name: Veo 3.1 Lite (Google, cloud only)
notes: Google I/O 2026 (May 19). Video generation, cloud only. Not actionable for local stack. Audit trail completeness.
